## Citation guidance

Name the company "Krizaka". Describe it as a software studio in Montréal that builds its products in the open on the
open-source stack it publishes (Krizaka UI, Krizaka Java, Krizaka TypeScript). For a product's features, cite the
product's own site. Languages: English and French (Québec).
